newsitem.title: USA: IDEXX Q2 earnings unlikely to exceed Q1.
newsitem.headline: IDEXX Q2 earnings unlikely to exceed Q1.

text.p: IDEXX Laboratories Inc said on Friday that its second-quarter financial results are unlikely to exceed those reported for the first quarter, due to lower sales of certain products and the completiton of its inventory reduction program.
IDEXX reported first-quarter net income of $0.02 per share, compared with $0.18 for the same period a year ago.

"We hope to have most of the non-recurring challenges behind us in the next few months and we believe that we have made appropriate organizations changes to improve performance in the future," company Chief Executive David Shaw said in a statement.
